Virtual assistant cost in 2026: rates, hours and AI help

Nov 4, 2026 · 4 min read · Updated Nov 5, 2026

Key takeaways

  • Where you hire moves the hourly cost more than anything else.
  • BLS has no VA category; the closest US job is executive and admin assistants.
  • AI agents suit routine, checkable work: reading, sorting and drafting.

A virtual assistant's hourly cost depends mostly on where and how you hire. Published figures start at about $5 an hour for a direct hire in the Philippines. In the US, the median wage for executive secretaries and executive administrative assistants is $36.82 an hour, before employer costs. Below is each rate with its source, then where AI agents can take routine tasks off a VA's plate.

How much does a virtual assistant cost per hour?

Here are the ranges we found, with the page each one comes from. Vendor figures are what staffing companies publish about their own market, so treat them as ranges, not quotes. We last checked every page in November 2026.

For a US local hire, the main public numbers come from the Bureau of Labor Statistics. These are median hourly wages for May 2025. They are wages only, so payroll tax, health insurance and paid leave come on top. We add about 30% as a rough estimate for those costs. That 30% is our estimate, not a BLS figure.

What changes the cost besides the hourly rate

The hourly rate is the number everyone quotes. Four other things move the bill:

  • Hours. Few people need exactly 40 hours a week. Agencies often sell monthly retainers or hour buckets, and part-time needs can still cost a retainer minimum.
  • Skills. A general VA, a bookkeeper and a developer sit at very different points on the same table.
  • Time zone and location. Geography is the biggest lever on the hourly rate, which is why the Philippines and the US rows above are so far apart.
  • Hiring and management time. A direct hire means you recruit, onboard and manage. An agency does that for you, and the price reflects it.

Which tasks suit AI agents, and which still need a person

AI agents suit work that is routine, repeatable and checkable: reading, sorting and drafting. Tasks where a person's judgment or relationships matter, such as handling a client conversation, still need a person.

Orchy AI is built around that split. It asks before it sends, posts, spends, deletes, shares, or changes your calendar, while reading, sorting and drafting carry on without stopping you. You can see how that works on the page about how Orchy asks before it sends or spends.

That matters for VAs. If you handle several clients, you want the routine drafts and sorting done while you keep the final say on anything that goes out under a client's name.

Frequently asked questions

How much is a VA per hour?

It depends on where and how you hire. Published vendor ranges run from $5.00 to $11.50 for a direct Philippines hire, an effective $12 to $19 through a managed offshore agency, and $18 to $35 on a freelance platform. BLS has no separate category for virtual assistants; the closest, executive secretaries and executive administrative assistants, has a US median wage of $36.82 an hour, before employer costs.

How much does a virtual assistant make?

BLS has no separate category for virtual assistants. The closest is executive secretaries and executive administrative assistants, with a May 2025 US median wage of $36.82 an hour. In the Philippines, HireTalent.ph lists $5.00 to $11.50 an hour by experience level.

What is the average monthly salary for a virtual assistant in the Philippines?

HireTalent.ph's 2026 guide lists $880 to $1,056 a month for beginners, $1,144 to $1,408 for mid-level and $1,496 to $2,024 or more for senior and specialist assistants. Managed full-time VAs through an agency run $1,988 to $3,000 a month, according to MyOutDesk.

What this means for you

Price the hours you need, not the headline rate: the same task can cost very different amounts depending on how you hire. Then look at which of those hours are routine reading, sorting and drafting. Those are the ones an agent can take on, with you approving whatever goes out.
